skill_router.description: Load only the skill the situation needs; trigger tables live inside each skill.

skills.name: customer-discovery
skills.summary: Interview frameworks and falsification checklists that surface real problems instead of validation.
skills.load_when: Planning, running, or debriefing customer interviews

skills.name: data-source-finder
skills.summary: Source hierarchy, credibility checks, and search strategies for market evidence; includes agent-native API research.
skills.load_when: A claim needs a source; market size, competitor, or benchmark data is questioned

skills.name: market-assumption-tracker
skills.summary: Structured logging, risk scoring, and evidence-based status tracking for business hypotheses.

skills.name: pivot-signal
skills.summary: Prediction-vs-actual tracking, signal severity classification, and pivot decision frameworks.
skills.load_when: Metrics diverge from predictions; persist-or-pivot is on the table
